objs.name: document
objs.description: A managed artifact subject to creation, editing, release, distribution, and archival in the document management system

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Classification of document such as Policy, Guideline, Procedural Instruction, or Work Instruction

attributes.name: abbreviation
attributes.description: Standardized prefix code assigned to document type

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Cross-client consecutive numeric identifier assigned per document type

attributes.name: title
attributes.description: Name or heading of the document

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of document such as Editing, Review, Released, or Out of Force

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version number of the document

attributes.name: valid_from_date
attributes.description: Date from which document becomes effective

attributes.name: valid_until_date
attributes.description: Calculated expiration date based on release date and validity period

attributes.name: validity_period
attributes.description: Default period of validity for document type such as 3 years

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Period before physical deletion such as 10 years

attributes.name: content
attributes.description: Substantive text or body of the document

attributes.name: metadata
attributes.description: Standardized and customer-specific properties maintained in categories

objs.name: policy
objs.description: Document type containing company-wide regulations and processes at strategic level

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Document type describing company-wide or locally defined regulations and instructions

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Document type describing specific procedures, process sequences, and responsible persons

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Document type containing detailed work steps and test instructions for sub-processes

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Non-critical document attachment not subject to main document release cycle

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Category such as brief instruction, photo, or screenshot

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document attachment subject to main document release cycle and versioning

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Sequential version of attachment aligned with main document

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Suggested amendment to an existing document created without affecting version history

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State of change proposal such as Pending or Completed

objs.name: user
objs.description: Individual person who participates in document management processes

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: Assigned responsibility such as Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator, or Reader

attributes.name: group
attributes.description: User Group membership such as Authors, Reviewers, Releasers, or Archive group

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Collection of users assigned with common authorization or distribution responsibility

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Category of group such as Reader, Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Translator, Business Admin, or Archive

attributes.name: name
attributes.description: Identifier for the user group

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Electronic attestation by workflow participant documenting approval or acknowledgement

attributes.name: participant
attributes.description: User who electronically signed

attributes.name: date
attributes.description: Timestamp of signature

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: System-generated workflow request to verify continued relevance of document approaching expiration

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State of validity extension request such as Pending or Approved

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Workflow request to invalidate and archive a document no longer applicable

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State of override request such as Pending or Approved

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Workflow request to restore and re-validate a previously invalidated document

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State of reactivation request such as Pending or Approved

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: Collection of users and user groups designated to receive document notification or acknowledgement requests

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Distribution method such as Email or Acknowledgement

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by document recipient that they have viewed and understood the released document

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: State of acknowledgement such as Pending or Confirmed

attributes.name: recipient
attributes.description: User who must confirm acknowledgement

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: Automated process guiding document through approval steps with participant tasks and notifications

attributes.name: type
attributes.description: Kind of workflow such as Release, Validity Extension, Override, or Reactivation

attributes.name: step
attributes.description: Current stage in workflow such as Creator, Review, or Release

objs.name: template
objs.description: Predefined document structure with metadata fields and content placeholders

attributes.name: format
attributes.description: Source format such as Word, Excel, or PowerPoint

objs.name: language_version
objs.description: Translated variant of a released document in an alternative language

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Target language of translation

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Workflow state of translation such as Editing or Released

objs.name: translator
objs.description: User responsible for translating released document content to alternative language

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: Instantiate a new document object in the system by selecting document type and optionally applying a template

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: Modify substantive text or body of a document using integrated editing client

evts.name: edit_document_properties
evts.description: Maintain metadata and attributes of document through property editing interface

evts.name: upload_document
evts.description: Attach external file or generate document from standard MS Office format into document object

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: Automatically convert edited document from source format to PDF representation

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Grant read or change permissions to user or user group for a document

evts.name: assign_workflow_participant
evts.description: Designate a user or group to participate in document approval process

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Submit suggested amendment to existing document without modifying version history

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Accept and incorporate a change proposal into a new document version

evts.name: initiate_release_process
evts.description: Start three-step approval workflow for document by author or co-author

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Electronically attest document during workflow step by authorized participant

evts.name: approve_document_review
evts.description: Complete reviewer tasks affirming document passes technical and formal checks

evts.name: approve_document_release
evts.description: Complete releaser task confirming document is ready for distribution to readers

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Make released document automatically visible to addressed readers

evts.name: create_document_version
evts.description: Generate new version of document triggered by content, property, or attachment changes

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark existing attachment as archived to be physically removed at next document version release

evts.name: extend_document_validity
evts.description: Confirm continued validity of released document and update expiration date

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: Automatically generate system request when document approaches 30 days before validity expiration

evts.name: process_validity_extension_request
evts.description: Workflow-supported decision to extend validity or initiate override of expiring document

evts.name: revise_document
evts.description: Create new version of released document with updated content and properties

evts.name: declare_override
evts.description: Invalidate and archive a released document that no longer has validity

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Initiate workflow process to invalidate a document by user with write access

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Initiate workflow to restore a previously invalidated document by Business Admin group member

evts.name: reactivate_document
evts.description: Restore and re-validate an invalidated document creating new version with preserved metadata

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Assign users and user groups to receive document notifications or acknowledgement requests

evts.name: send_distribution_email
evts.description: Automatically notify assigned users and groups when new document version is released

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Automatically send acknowledgement workflow tasks to users on distribution list when version released

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: Actively confirm receipt and understanding of document by designated recipient

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Create language-dependent variant of released document for alternative language users

evts.name: review_translation
evts.description: Check translated document content and properties through workflow

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Approve translated document making it visible to readers in target language

evts.name: view_document_dashboard
evts.description: Access user-role and distribution-specific dashboard displaying relevant documents

evts.name: generate_report
evts.description: Create role-specific evaluation report of documents with selected parameters and criteria
